title: Acceptance oracle on encoded queries
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, and let $x,\beta$ be bit strings and $u,s$ nonnegative integers. The oracle's answer on the encoding of the pair whose first component encodes $(x,\beta)$ and whose second component encodes $(u,s)$ is true exactly when the encoding of $(x,u,s)$ belongs to the acceptance language of $N$.
